questions.prompt: In SASS, what is c[0x0][0x164] in FFMA R7, R2, c[0x0][0x164], R7?
options: A value in the constant bank, here a kernel parameter, used directly as an operand
questions.explanation: Kernel parameters live in a constant bank that instructions can read directly.

questions.prompt: You see LDL and STL instructions inside a hot loop. What does that usually mean?
questions.explanation: Local memory is per-thread memory in DRAM (cached): spilling there is slow.

questions.prompt: A loop body has 16 FFMA, 2 LDS.128 and 4 other instructions. FMA share, in %?
What did the compiler do with if (i < n) in the saxpy SASS?
options: Turned it into a predicated EXIT for threads with i ≥ n

questions.prompt: What do SASS control bits encode?
options: Scheduling information the compiler sets: stall counts, yields and dependency barriers
questions.explanation: That's how the compiler tells the hardware when results will be ready.
